title: FOIA Request Form - Chicago Office of Inspector General
text: FOIA Request Form Home > Contact Us > FOIA Request Form The public has the right to request records from any government agency through the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), commonly known as the law that keeps citizens in the know about their government. As the Office of Inspector General (OIG) strives to make the operations of City government more transparent, it is mindful of its responsibility to ensure that its own operations are transparent. Below, you can find information on OIG’s budget, staffing, organization, and operations. If you cannot find what you are looking for, there are also instructions on how you can submit a FOIA request. All requests for records must be made in writing and must include a description of the records being requested. Please include your name, email, or mailing address. If you seek records for a commercial purpose, you must disclose that in your request. OIG’s FOIA officers are Callie Folke and Curtis Ascher . You may submit your FOIA request by mail, fax, email, or using the FOIA online form . Email : oigfoia@igchicago.org Fax number : (773) 478-3949 Mailing address : FOIA Officer 231 S. LaSalle Street, 12th Floor Chicago, Illinois 60604 The following categories of records are maintained by OIG: Investigative records, such as complaints and reports OIG budget requests OIG operational records OIG personnel records Records related to Audit and Program Review projects Records related to Compliance activity Reports required under the OIG Ordinance PLEASE NOTE : Due to the nature of OIG’s work and strict confidentiality provisions of the Ordinance, a substantial portion of records are exempt from disclosure as provided by section 7.5(h) of the Illinois FOIA. Therefore, records listed above may not be subject to disclosure. The following documents are available immediately on our website: OIG hiring statistics OIG organizational chart OIG rules and regulations Press releases Publicly issued audits and reports Quarterly reports issued pursuant to the OIG ordinance OIG does not physically inspect businesses or buildings for City permits or code violations, and thus, does not maintain such records. A diagram of OIG’s organizational structure and functional subdivisions may be found here . OIG derives its authority from the OIG ordinance, which contains strict confidentiality provisions. OIG files reports with the City Council, which also possesses other responsibilities related to OIG as provided in the Municipal Code of Chicago. Please note that it is within OIG’s discretion whether to grant the waiver. " * " indicates required fields You may use the form below to submit a FOIA request.
